case_title: LIU VICTORIA VS SEA WAVE HAIR SALON

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,500.00 FILED BY LIU VICTORIA AS TO DEFENDANT SEA WAVE HAIR SALON ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-07-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
INVALID SERVICE AS TO DEFEND, NO MAILING, DESCRIPTION OF PERSON CLAIM WAS GIVEN TO.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LIU VICTORIA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SEA WAVE HAIR SALON THE PLAINTIFF HAS THE BURDEN OF PROOF. PLFT DID NOT PROVE HER CASE FOR LIABILITY OR FOR DAMAGES. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
